translations.web: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and flourished; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites.
translations.kjv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread abroad. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
